messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: 5xx spike detected on prod-gateway (edge) — error rate 18% over 2m, latency spike. Paging oncall.
oncall-amber: acked — I'm on it. collecting initial logs and tracing. please DM if urgent.
samir: oncall-amber can you paste the top error signatures? I can pull cert-related traces if it's TLS.
oncall-amber: copying the top lines from the gateway logs now — looks like TLS handshake failures + short-lived 502s

```
2026-03-15T02:21:09Z edge-proxy[pid:4321] TLS handshake failed: ssl_handshake_library: ssl3_get_server_certificate:certificate verify failed
2026-03-15T02:21:12Z edge-proxy[pid:4321] upstream request failed: 502, context=handshake_failure
```

ellie: also seeing a surge of `x-forwarded-for: -` with empty SNI on some connections, odd.
ryan-sre: running `openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod:443 -servername api.redwood.example.com` from our healthcheck host shows `verify error:num=10:certificate has expired` on the leaf cert chain.

samir: hmm. which cert bundle is that host serving? Could be a bad upload to secret manager or wrong key encoding. I'll check the cert SHA and rotation history.
oncall-amber: routing traffic to fallback pool (low-priority) now to reduce customer impact. steering id: `steer-2026-03-15-02` — expect latency to improve in ~30s.

gateway-team: @samir FYI the recent cert rotation job ran ~01:50 UTC and reported success. we have the k8s secret named `prod-gateway-tls` rotated by `cert-rotator-v2`.

samir: pulling cert from secret manager and decoding:
```
$ kubectl -n infra get secret prod-gateway-tls -o jsonpath='{.data.tls.crt}' | base64 -d | openssl x509 -noout -text
Error opening Certificate 0
1402453...: ASN1 parser: truncated data
```

ellie: that looks like encoding corruption. possibly truncated during upload. any chance of partial writes from rotator? gateway-team: rotator logs show `PUT secret succeeded` but no size checks.
ryan-sre: checking backup copies. I can fetch last known-good from kv-store (version v2026-03-14T23:40).

ops-bot: Found backup secret `prod-gateway-tls@2026-03-14T23:40` in vault-cluster-1. size: 3.2KB. current secret size: 1.4KB.
oncall-amber: OK we have confirmation of corrupted cert in current secret. rollback to backup and trigger reload on edge proxies. Samir, can you push that? I'll execute the traffic rollback plan if you confirm.

samir: re-applying backup now:
```
$ kubectl -n infra delete secret prod-gateway-tls
$ kubectl -n infra apply -f prod-gateway-tls-backup.yaml
secret/prod-gateway-tls created
```

samir: triggered proxy config reload: `kubectl -n edge rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy` — rolling restarts started.

ellie: monitoring TLS handshake success rate... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ryan-sre: healthcheck -> 200 responses returning. handshake errors dropping immediately after first restart pod came up.

oncall-amber: traffic steering back to primary pool now (steer-2026-03-15-02 => PRIMARY). watch for customer-facing 5xxs.

incident-bot: Customer impact: API clients experienced elevated 5xx rates for ~13 minutes. Affected regions: us-east-1 primarily. No data exfiltration detected. Incident severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation.

gateway-team: quick root cause: cert-rotator-v2 uploaded a truncated PEM due to a bug in the upload path when certs exceed a multipart threshold. the secret ended up corrupted and proxies served a bad cert causing verify errors.

samir: filed a hotfix to rotator: `fix/rotator-payload-split` — patch will add size validation and post-upload verification (openssl parse) before marking success. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rotator/pulls/432

ellie: ops followup: create a scheduled job that validates active TLS bundles every 6 hours and alert on parsing errors. also add a canary rotation pipeline.

oncall-amber: handing off to day oncall @ryan-sre for post-incident cleanups and postmortem. I've documented timeline and mitigation steps in the incident runbook. Please confirm handoff.
ryan-sre: taking it. I'll coordinate postmortem, include customer impact table and RCA. tagging gateway-team and rotator owners.

oncall-amber: thanks everyone. adding TODOs: postmortem, deploy rotator hotfix, add cert validation monitor, verify all active secrets > backup integrity. :white_check_mark:

samir: one more note — any clients that had cached intermediate chains might have continued to fail until their caches expired. recommend communications team draft an advisory for customers who saw transient failures.

incident-bot: Incident closed. Please link postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:
